verdict.rationale: LibreChat publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at librechat.ai/openapi.json, and its GitHub README documents a beta Agent Management API, so a first-party API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer (Swagger/try-it UI) or runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference UI, runnable or try-it examples, in-depth API reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
